creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Raised 2026-10-19 on 0.17.0. Both marketplaces in `extras/` are named `muster`, but Claude Code's lists a plugin `muster` and Codex's lists `muster-codex`, so Muster's plugin is `muster@muster` in Claude Code and `muster-codex@muster` in Codex. A launcher that mirrors Claude Code's `enabledPlugins` into Codex, enabling each key whose marketplace Codex has registered, fails on every Codex start with ``Error: plugin `muster` was not found in marketplace `muster` ``. Nothing breaks, since `muster harness install codex` has already enabled `muster-codex@muster`, but the error prints at every launch.

7aa474be chose the plugin's name and gives no reason for the difference. If nothing depends on it, naming the Codex plugin `muster` as well would give each harness the same key for its own plugin; `muster harness install codex` would then need to move existing installs off `muster-codex@muster`. Other options: a second entry named `muster` in the Codex marketplace pointing at `./codex`, or leaving the names and expecting such launchers to skip a key whose plugin the target marketplace does not list.
title: Codex's plugin is muster-codex where Claude Code's is muster: should they share a name?
